meta.title: The AI Builder's Toolbox
meta.tagline: What to reach for, by the thing you're actually trying to do.
meta.note: Every link here was checked against the GitHub API or a live HTTP request on 2026-08-13 — 149 of 149 resolved. Entries marked ★ are ones I've personally used, not just bookmarked.

domains.title: Start Here
domains.blurb: If you only open six links, open these.

entries.name: Claude Code
entries.desc: The terminal coding agent everything else on this page plugs into.

entries.name: Claude Docs / API
entries.desc: Model IDs, pricing, prompt caching, tool use — the primary source, not a blog post.

entries.name: anthropics/skills
entries.desc: Official Agent Skills repo. Read one SKILL.md and you'll understand the whole format.

entries.name: anthropics/claude-plugins-official
entries.desc: Anthropic-curated plugin directory. Safest place to install from first.

entries.name: hesreallyhim/awesome-claude-code
entries.desc: The big hand-picked community list. Go here when this page doesn't have it.

entries.name: Model Context Protocol
entries.desc: The spec behind MCP servers. Worth 20 minutes before you install your first one.

domains.title: Frontend & Design
domains.blurb: Stopping your agent from producing generic purple-gradient slop.

entries.name: pbakaus/impeccable
entries.desc: A design language you drop in so the agent stops defaulting to bootstrap-brain.

entries.name: Leonxlnx/taste-skill
entries.desc: Gives the model actual taste. The anti-slop skill people mean when they say anti-slop.

entries.name: Nutlope/hallmark
entries.desc: Same job as the two above, different opinion. Works in Claude Code, Cursor and Codex.

entries.name: VoltAgent/awesome-design-md
entries.desc: DESIGN.md files reverse-engineered from real brand systems. Drop one in your repo.

entries.name: google-labs-code/design.md
entries.desc: The actual spec for describing a visual identity to a coding agent.

entries.name: 21st.dev
entries.desc: Component marketplace + MCP so the agent can pull real UI instead of inventing it.

entries.name: shadcn/ui
entries.desc: The component library most agent-generated React lands on. Know it.

entries.name: shadcn/improve
entries.desc: Use your best model to audit the codebase, then let a cheap model execute the plan.

entries.name: nexu-io/open-design
entries.desc: Local-first desktop app; open-source take on Claude Design.

entries.name: facebook/astryx
entries.desc: Open-source design system built to be driven by an agent.

entries.name: alchaincyf/huashu-design
entries.desc: HTML-native design skill — good when you want markup, not a framework.

entries.name: nexu-io/html-anything
entries.desc: Agentic HTML editor. Agent writes the markup, you ship it.

entries.name: Tailwind CSS
entries.desc: Assume every agent already knows it. Fight this and you'll lose.

entries.name: oil-oil/oil-motion
entries.desc: Smooth, responsive web animations without hand-rolling easing curves.

entries.name: Jakubantalik/thinking-orbs
entries.desc: Loading indicators built specifically for AI/agent UIs. Small but you'll want it.

entries.name: Figma
entries.desc: Still where the design actually gets decided before code touches it.

domains.title: Diagrams & Visual Explainers
domains.blurb: For when the answer is a picture, not a paragraph.

entries.name: cathrynlavery/diagram-design
entries.desc: 29 editorial diagram types as clean HTML+SVG. No Mermaid look, no drop shadows.

entries.name: tt-a1i/archify
entries.desc: Architecture, sequence, data-flow and lifecycle diagrams that are actually verifiable.

entries.name: coleam00/excalidraw-diagram-skill
entries.desc: Makes any coding agent produce real Excalidraw files.

entries.name: yizhiyanhua-ai/fireworks-tech-graph
entries.desc: Natural language in, production-quality SVG/PNG technical diagrams out.

entries.name: Excalidraw
entries.desc: The hand-drawn whiteboard. Fastest path from head to shareable picture.

entries.name: Mermaid
entries.desc: Diagrams as text. Renders natively in GitHub and most docs tools.

domains.title: Context & Token Management
domains.blurb: The single biggest lever on cost and on whether long sessions stay coherent.

entries.name: JuliusBrussee/caveman
entries.desc: "Why use many token when few token do trick." Cuts roughly 65% of tokens.

entries.name: DietrichGebert/ponytail
entries.desc: Makes the agent think like the laziest senior dev alive. Best code is the code you don't write.

entries.name: Mibayy/token-savior
entries.desc: MCP server that held 97.9% on a real coding benchmark at 80% fewer active tokens.

entries.name: thomaschill/unclog
entries.desc: Audits which MCP servers, skills and CLAUDE.md bloat are eating your context window.

entries.name: DeusData/codebase-memory-mcp
entries.desc: Indexes a codebase into a persistent knowledge graph so the agent stops re-reading everything.

entries.name: MemPalace/mempalace
entries.desc: Best-benchmarked open-source memory system, and free.

entries.name: TencentCloud/TencentDB-Agent-Memory
entries.desc: Team-level shared memory hub rather than per-developer memory.

domains.title: RAG & Knowledge Graphs
domains.blurb: Getting your own material into the model reliably.

entries.name: HKUDS/LightRAG
entries.desc: Simple, fast, graph-flavoured RAG. The default I'd start from.

entries.name: HKUDS/RAG-Anything
entries.desc: All-in-one RAG framework from the same lab when LightRAG isn't enough.

entries.name: Graphify-Labs/graphify
entries.desc: Turns a codebase plus its docs, schemas and PDFs into a queryable knowledge graph.

entries.name: vitali87/code-graph-rag
entries.desc: RAG aimed squarely at multi-language monorepos.

entries.name: tirth8205/code-review-graph
entries.desc: Local-first persistent map of your codebase, exposed over MCP and CLI.

entries.name: langchain-ai/openwiki
entries.desc: Writes and then maintains agent-facing docs for your repo.

entries.name: pgvector/pgvector
entries.desc: Vectors inside Postgres. Usually the right answer before you buy a vector DB.

entries.name: Chroma
entries.desc: Easiest local vector store to get running in an afternoon.

domains.title: Second Brain & Notes
domains.blurb: Where the knowledge lives when it isn't code.

entries.name: Obsidian
entries.desc: Plain markdown on your disk. That's exactly why agents work well against it.

entries.name: kepano/obsidian-skills
entries.desc: Teaches your agent the Obsidian CLI and open formats. From Obsidian's own CEO.

entries.name: AgriciDaniel/claude-obsidian
entries.desc: Self-organising second brain — drop any source in and it files itself.

entries.name: NotebookLM
entries.desc: Best free tool for interrogating a pile of sources you didn't write.

entries.name: teng-lin/notebooklm-py
entries.desc: Unofficial Python API + skill. Gets you features the web UI doesn't expose.

entries.name: pjeby/hot-reload
entries.desc: Auto-reloads Obsidian plugins while you build them. Tiny, essential.

domains.title: Research & Intelligence
domains.blurb: Finding out what's actually true and actually current.

entries.name: mvanhorn/last30days-skill
entries.desc: Researches a topic across Reddit, X, YouTube, HN and Polymarket. My most-used research skill.

entries.name: Panniantong/Agent-Reach
entries.desc: Gives the agent eyes on Twitter, Reddit and YouTube instead of guessing.

entries.name: Firecrawl
entries.desc: Search and scrape the live web at scale, in a format models can read.

entries.name: firecrawl/anydoc
entries.desc: Word, PowerPoint, Excel, EPUB, PDF → clean Markdown.

entries.name: baidu/Unlimited-OCR
entries.desc: One-shot parsing of very long documents. Good where normal OCR falls over.

entries.name: karpathy/autoresearch
entries.desc: Agents running their own research loop. Worth reading even if you never run it.

entries.name: koala73/worldmonitor
entries.desc: Real-time news and geopolitical dashboard, AI-aggregated.

entries.name: HKUDS/DeepTutor
entries.desc: Personalised tutoring that persists across sessions.

entries.name: every-app/open-seo
entries.desc: Open-source answer to Semrush and Ahrefs.

entries.name: phuryn/pm-skills

entries.name: coreyhaines31/marketingskills

entries.name: slavingia/skills
entries.desc: Sahil Lavingia's skills, built around The Minimalist Entrepreneur.

entries.name: Shubhamsaboo/awesome-llm-apps

entries.name: anthropics/claude-cookbooks

entries.name: FlorianBruniaux/claude-code-ultimate-guide

entries.name: asgeirtj/system_prompts_leaks

entries.name: OpenRouter

entries.name: googleworkspace/cli

entries.name: iOfficeAI/OfficeCLI
entries.desc: Office suite built so agents can read and edit documents directly.

entries.name: herdrdev/herdr
entries.desc: A runtime for your coding agents to actually live on.

entries.name: junegunn/fzf

entries.name: BurntSushi/ripgrep

entries.name: sharkdp/bat
